responsibility: Defines the RTL operand predicates used by the GCN machine description to recognize legal scalar, vector, conditional, immediate, memory, and unspec operands. These predicates encode target-specific register-file distinctions, inline-constant forms, DS/LDS memory operands, compare operator classes, and special vector/EXEC forms, giving instruction patterns in gcn.md and gcn-valu.md precise operand admissibility tests during recognition and reload.
